name: tsbecm-202
description: Convert technical drawing images into editable, dimensioned CAD with checked PDF previews.

interface.longDescription: Redraw photographed and scanned technical drawings as editable 2D CAD. Read dimensions, symbols and annotations, reconcile dimension chains and related views, and create native CAD geometry, layers and dimensions with a vector PDF preview. Separate source measurements, calculated values and unresolved information. Includes checks for saved DXF integrity, measured dimensions, holes, slopes and plot settings. Responds to Darija, Arabic, French and English requests. Requires a host with image/file access and Python execution; Python dependencies are included as a requirements file. DXF is the default editable format. Genuine DWG output requires an available CAD application or converter. Drawing reconstruction does not establish structural adequacy or confirm missing source dimensions.
defaultPrompt: Redraw this technical drawing as editable DXF with all readable dimensions and a checked PDF preview.
Check the dimensions and annotations in this drawing. Flag missing information before creating the CAD file.
Use the TSBECM 202 workflow to produce organized CAD layers, native dimensions and an uncertainty report.

prompts: Redraw the attached technical drawing as editable DXF with native dimensions and a PDF. Separate readable, derived and unresolved dimensions.
This photographed detail has a conflicting dimension chain. Identify the conflict and draw only the confirmed geometry.
Inspect the generated DXF, measure the actual entities, and return the editable file, a scaled PDF and a verification note.

publication.release_notes: Adds a manual GPT compatibility kit with instructions, knowledge, profile icon and preview cases, plus a precise ChatGPT account-plugin setup guide. Documents current GPT creation eligibility. CAD workflow behavior is unchanged.
